title: Rust (and Slint) on a Jailbroken Kindle
summary: A developer demonstrates how to cross-compile Rust applications for a jailbroken Kindle e-reader, featuring the Slint UI framework for building interfaces. The article covers setting up the cross-compilation toolchain, dependencies, and running compiled binaries on the ARM-based Kindle device.
problem_solved: Enables running native Rust applications with UI on a jailbroken Kindle e-reader device.
why_valuable: Demonstrates practical cross-compilation workflows for embedded devices and explores running modern UI frameworks on unconventional hardware platforms.
